ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base layer of contiguous low-intensity black pixels across both lobes; secondary mapping includes numerous discrete high-intensity white circular blobs (2-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the central and distal surfaces, with larger amorphous white regions concentrated at the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending to the lower 1/6th of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration profile along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 and 25 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the inner and outer leading edges; lobes exhibit an upward and outward orientation relative to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters; higher density of clusters observed on the right lobe compared to the left.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-gray to white) detected on the mid-section of the right lobe and proximal to the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular trailing edge notches and dense white point-source scarring patterns distributed across the ventral surface.
